headline: Banco Macro Launches Private Banking Unit for Clients With Over $1 Million
summary: Banco Macro introduced Macro Private Bank, a wealth management unit aimed at clients with more than $1 million in assets, seeking to repatriate funds held in foreign institutions.
why: Banco Macro is one of Argentina's largest private commercial banks, expanding fee-generating wealth management services.

impacts.name: Banco Macro
impacts.why: Banco Macro launched a new private banking division targeting high-net-worth clients holding upwards of $1 million.
